title: docs(qa): re-point the half-A platform-checklist items that described an older product
body:
Part of #24036
Clause-②: no

Half A of the ledger card: the stale items in eight area files under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`. Those files are `access-security`, `ai`, `search`, `api-backend`, `approvals`, `attachments-storage`, `automation` and `cli`. Half B owns the other eight files and is a separate PR. This PR does not close the card, which stays open for half B.

Each revised item gets the following:
- a bumped `revision`;
- a `history` row naming #24036 that carries the reading;
- a green `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`.

Where a revision changed a fixture, a step's request or an oracle, the item was re-run once against a real app built from this tree (`checklist-test` §3). That means framework `c91af8ed6` with the console at objectui `f8267df93aba`. The re-runs are recorded in one `qa-run` record per area:

| area | record | judged | verdicts |
|---|---|---|---|
| access-security | #24104 | 12/35 | 1 pass, 11 partial |
| ai | #24105 | 5/10 | 1 pass, 4 partial |
| search | #24106 | 1/8 | 1 partial |
| api-backend | #24107 | 11/27 | 11 partial |
| approvals | #24108 | 8/20 | 1 pass, 7 partial |
| attachments-storage | #24109 | 5/11 | 5 partial |
| automation | #24111 | 10/22 | 10 partial |
| cli | #24114 | 9/22 | 9 partial |

`partial` here is the derived verdict of a scoped re-run. The clauses a revision touched were driven and passed, and the item's other clauses were skipped as outside the run. No clause failed in any record. Product code is untouched, and the only changed paths are the eight area files: +659 / -316.

## What changed, per item

### access-security (15 items)
- `write-path-guards` r5:
  - the steps now give the wire shapes (bare-array createMany, `{records:[{id,data}]}` updateMany);
  - the mixed-outcome step sends `continueOnError`, because the default run stops at the first failure.
  - Re-run in #24104.
- `readonly-package-locks-studio` r5: step 5 says the package manifest needs `type` and the scratch object needs `sharingModel`. Re-run.
- `crud-permission-matrix` r6:
  - 45 rows, 4 of them delegate rows;
  - the #21057 known-fail gap is removed, because #21057 closed and the in-subtree create answers 201.
  - Re-run.
- `fls-mask-and-strip` r4: clause 4 scores the two budget controls the form renders. `budget_remaining` is a formula field and is not on the form. Re-run in the browser.
- `sharing-rules-widen` r2:
  - the position variant is confounded by manager depth, so it is recorded but not scored, and the clauses run on the unit rule;
  - A13 edits the `sys_sharing_rule` row, because `sys_record_share` PATCH answers 405;
  - a manual share needs object-level read.
  - Re-run.
- `record-share-grant-revoke` r5: `source[1]` names `sharing-routes.ts#registerSharingEndpoints`. Anchor only, no re-run owed.
- `audit-log-browser` r5: a fresh member gets 403 at the object gate, so the parent-record gate rests on the plugin-audit visibility pins. Re-run.
- `public-form-intake` r3:
  - the anonymous row's `owner_id` is null;
  - `/forms/:name` answers 302 to `/_console/f/:name`.
  - Re-run.
- `share-link-capability-tokens` r7:
  - `Vary` *includes* the two share-password headers, because CORS appends `Origin`;
  - an email audience gives a uniform 404 `INVALID_OR_EXPIRED`;
  - `emailAllowlist` is required.
  - Re-run.
- `sharing-rule-authoring-ui` r3: two rules are seeded, one on `showcase_contact`, and the Setup nav source is corrected. Wording only.
- `capability-declaration-lifecycle` r4:
  - `sys_capability` is retired;
  - the dispatcher `/actions` domain is the surface;
  - the regrant leg runs on a clone, because `showcase_ops` is sealed;
  - step 6 now says a platform-name shadow is refused at **boot**, while validate and build pass it.
  - Re-run, build legs included.
- `activation-write-operator-gate` r3: the posture oracle is the `Tenancy: single` banner line. Re-run.
- `platform-owner-email-anchor` r3: the entitled leg now precedes the malformed list, so the sibling check discriminates. Re-run on one scratch DB across five restarts.
- `record-view-read-audit` r2:
  - the stock leg boots at `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info` with a positive control;
  - the stock leg reads `showcase_account`, because a baseline member is refused `showcase_contact`;
  - a scripted scratch-copy recipe covers the configured half.
  - Re-run on both halves.
- `share-link-landing-page` r3: the objectui pin text is updated to `f8267df93aba`. Wording only.

### ai (6 items)
- `mcp-validate-expression` r3: the field is `estimate_hours`, not `est_hours`. Re-run in #24105.
- `mcp-run-action-exposure-gate` r3: `list_actions` takes no arguments; `objectName` answers -32602. Re-run.
- `mcp-http-surface` r3: `resume_run` is in the tool list. Re-run.
- `agent-tool-skill-metadata-roundtrip` r5: `?mode=draft` answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`. Re-run.
- `mcp-stdio-fail-closed` r6, residual:
  - a fixture note: on `os start`, a sign-in that carries a Cookie header and no Origin answers 403 `MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN`, while `os dev` accepts it;
  - cookie-less sign-in and key minting are unaffected.
  - Runner note only.
- `skill-instructions-mcp-prompts` r2:
  - step 5 names what makes a source edit live (the watcher's rebuild and restart, `objectstack build` or `--compile`) and the runtime PUT route;
  - a bare restart serves the stale dist at `/meta` while the MCP projection follows the source (measured).
  - Re-run, pass.

### search (2 items)
- `pinyin-flag-both-sides` r4:
  - `wf` is the contact 王芳, not an account;
  - the roster reads 51 vs 52, and the one-plugin difference is the oracle.
  - Re-run on both boots in #24106.
- `global-search-skips-unreadable` r2: the flag defaults ON through zh-CN, so a run must set it false. Wording only.

### api-backend (11 items, re-runs in #24107)
- `error-envelope-ledger` r4: `BATCH_NOT_ATOMIC` needs a top-level `atomic:false`.
- `bulk-write-contract` r2: the doors are id-based, and the member has no `allowDelete`.
- `package-rest-lifecycle` r3: scope `project`, and clause 4 scores 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` instead of message text.
- `route-ledger-live-parity` r4: 18 families; the `reports` family was retired.
- `server-timing-admin-gated` r4: the spans are parse, db, serialize, handler and total.
- `rest-metadata-config-contract` r4: the masking fixture is `showcase_project` with `client_liaison`.
- `aggregate-contract-matrix` r2: it now uses `search:qa-contributor-bound-member`.
- `batch-transactional-discovery` r5: `project` is required.
- `enforce-or-remove-authoring-gates` r4: the strip-by-design control is an unknown key on `RestServerConfig.routes`.
- `declarative-endpoint-execution` r3: three endpoints; `os build` reports "3 APIs".
- `retired-def-refusal` r2:
  - steps sample defs by carrier. A def is either reached through a retired-key tombstone (`manifest.loading`, `agent.lifecycle`) or is a zero-consumer schema export, driven through its import.
  - the control is an invented stack key and an invented type.
  - No clause changed.

### approvals (8 items, re-runs in #24108)
- `approver-resolution-matrix` r4 (residual): the bindings flow ships `obsolete`, and there is a runtime flow door.
- `ooo-delegation-reroute` r6: runtime flow registration on stock. Full re-run, pass.
- `status-mirror-field` r2: runtime flows; scoped re-run.
- `per-group-signoff` r7: a mismatched `actorId` is refused 403 "cannot act as".
- `decision-action-matrix` r5: request-info is approver-only.
- `email-action-token-door` r3: the dead-slot leg reassigns with `from`.
- `record-page-decisions` r2: the served route is `/record/:id`, and a non-override persona now covers the both-sides clause.
- `pending-count-surfaces` r2: the #7344 gap is stale; member surfaces were measured with ten pending approvals.

### attachments-storage (5 items, re-runs in #24109)
- `attach-requires-parent-edit` r7: a non-reader outsider gets 404, a reader outsider gets 403.
- `sys-file-status-pipeline` r3: the hooked re-attach un-tombstones, and the tombstone-download pin is named.
- `upload-session-abort` r4: a bogus eTag gives 409 before the backend, so `failed` is reachable only through the test seam.
- `field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced` r2: 400 `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT`; the oracle moves from log to api.
- `download-authz-both-sides` r5:
  - step 7 drives the reachable shape: persona A's open panel, A's grant revoked, then Download;
  - persona B never reaches the panel.
  - Re-run in the browser.
- The `qa-scratch-authz` recipe mints three invited members and pins the three permission-set payloads.

### automation (10 items, re-runs in #24111)
- `trigger-type-matrix` r4 and `time-relative-trigger` r3: the scheduled legs need `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`.
- These five walk a task to done through `in_review` with its required project:
  - `flow-node-type-matrix` r6;
  - `flow-error-handling` r4;
  - `packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal` r3;
  - `connector-dispatch-matrix` r3;
  - `flow-toggle-kill-switch` r3.
- `flow-node-type-matrix` also names the self-pinging http recipe.
- `connector-dispatch-matrix`'s premise guard reads the exported `OS_PORT` and a completed run, because `/connectors` carries no `baseUrl`.
- `trigger-status-contract` r2: the `qa_always_fails` recipe authors an `errorMessage`.
- `packaged-flow-disable-durable` r3: the log corroboration needs `--log-level info`.
- `packaged-flow-clone-contract` r3:
  - the #21332 reachability expected-fail is stale (objectui#11553), because Studio's org scope lists and opens the package-less clone;
  - the clone survives a cold restart and still dispatches.

### cli (9 items, re-runs in #24114)
- `hook-body-extraction-gates` r3: the expected-fail flipped. The default build prints "N handlers could not be lowered…", `--json` carries `bodyExtractionWarnings`, and the clause now fails if that goes silent.
- `build-own-contract` r5: the advisory key sits at a strip-mode site (a field's object-form `visibleWhen`) under `strict:false`; a key on a field is a hard refusal.
- `dev-automigrate-policy` r2:
  - the datasource is named and mapped as default, because a datasource named `default` is refused;
  - drift is staged with `storage.notNull`;
  - `relax_not_null` is needs_confirm;
  - the safe specimen is a planted legacy unique index;
  - the schema dump replaces `os migrate plan` as the pending oracle (see below).
- `dev-boot-contract` r5: the config-declared default is a named datasource plus `datasourceMapping {default:true, datasource}`.
- `migrate-duplicates-inventory` r7: the overlay index is `(type, name, package_id, bundle_member)`, and `sys_metadata` has no `organization_id`.
- `doctor-health-report` r3: the staged config must load. A malformed view body makes doctor skip config analysis, while a well-formed orphan container loads.
- `datasource-introspect-codegen` r5: the scratch namespace must match the draft's prefix.
- `scaffold-console-first-paint` r4:
  - the port lever is `OS_PORT` / `-p`;
  - the scaffold serves its own installed `@objectstack/console`, not `.objectui-sha`.
- `scaffold-first-run` r5: on the 18 line, skills sync from `@objectstack/skills` in node_modules and are compared against that package's catalog.

## Findings disproved or routed (no ledger edit)
- `api-backend.date-range-preset-matrix`: disproved. No item text claims where a rolling window ends, and `last_7_days` ends today as the item already implies.
- `cli.doctor-health-report` ("orphan-view staging needs `strict:false`"): only half held. A malformed body is refused by the default load, but a well-formed orphan container loads under the default `defineStack`. The step now says which.
- `approvals.quorum-m-of-n` duplicate-slot count is product-side (objectstack-ai/objectui#12781).
- `automation.flow-runs-page-test-trigger` picker labels are product-side (objectstack-ai/objectui#12783).
- The public-form heading pointer was withdrawn by comment 6225030762.

## Left, with reason
- `automation.time-relative-trigger`: only the binding leg was re-run. The due-date sweep was not driven.
- `approvals.status-mirror-field`: the returned / maxRevisions / cascade legs were not re-run.
- `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor` clause 6: the posture-split unit pins were not run in this pass.
- The two scaffold items were measured from `create-objectstack@next` (18.0.0-next.2). `@latest` is 17.7.0 and depends on no `@objectstack/skills`.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` is outside this card's file surface but still says two stale things:
  - its connector self-URL fact reads a `baseUrl` that `/automation/connectors` does not carry;
  - its scheduled-work notes predate the opt-in.
  These are reported for the seat; this PR does not touch RUNNER.md.

## Acceptance notes
- Open PR #24054's anchor line in `access-security.json` (`public-form-withdrawal-layers`) is untouched.
- Observed outside any clause: `os migrate plan` on a project whose primary store is a config-declared datasource "Examined 0 managed table(s)" and printed a PARTIAL plan, while the dev boot of the same config reported three drifts in that file. The report carries the card draft.
- Observed outside any clause: Home's Activity feed card shows "An unexpected error occurred." for non-admin members, because `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity` answers 403. The report carries the card draft.

## Gates (local subset, at `364c08264`)
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 13 commands. Each one ran and exited 0, with the exit code captured before any pipe:
  - `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (plus `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`;
  - `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`;
  - `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`;
  - `check:platform-checklist`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:watch-hint-literal`.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).
- `check-governed-merges --branch claude/issue-24036-ledger-a`: NOT governed; 975 changed lines.
- Pins run under the verify lock as evidence, all green:
  - mcp `skill-prompts.test.ts` (12);
  - driver-sql `sql-driver-unique-tenancy` + `sql-driver-schema-drift` (38);
  - service-storage `storage-routes` + `tombstone-download-live-reference` (57);
  - plugin-audit `audit-log-read-visibility` (unit + integration) + `read-audit` (70).
- The seat applies `skip-changeset`, because only the docs ledger changed.
